summary: Rebuilt validation into a read-only doc-03 integrity engine with typed-model document checks, ordered reference integrity, task and claim graph rules, structural and secret safety, strict mode, pluggable projection freshness, stable actionable diagnostics, and adversarial regression coverage.
behavior_implemented: Preserved the consumed validation API and original report/issue fields while adding keyword-only strict mode, repair actions, advisories, and optional freshness probing.
Validated context, entity, task, artifact, observation, and claim documents through integrated runtime domain models and shared frontmatter parsing.
Built deterministic in-memory identity and relation indexes and enforced reference parse, boundary, D-018 vocabulary, and resolution order.
Validated workspace task hierarchy, normalized blocks/depends_on precedence, and detected cycles with an iterative graph algorithm.
Enforced half-open claim intervals, efficient current-overlap detection, supersession target existence, and supersession acyclicity.
Defined FreshnessProbe with a null implementation and sanitized stale, unknown, backlink-mismatch, and probe-failure diagnostics without importing adapters.
Hardened exact-case structure, UTF-8, unreadable paths, absolute and non-portable paths, symlink/junction boundaries, secret detection, and federated-search checks without writing workspace data.
Documented every diagnostic code with severity, cause, and repair action and enforced documentation/catalog synchronization in tests.

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 35 source files.
14 changed paths from the assigned base through reports; 0 outside contract allowed_paths.
Exit code 0; no forbidden tracked path changed.

assumptions: Every exact claim subject plus predicate slot is single-valued in Phase 1; arrays carry intentional multi-values.
Claim validity intervals are half-open and missing bounds are open-ended.
Task relation cycles use prerequisite-to-dependent normalization, and reciprocal claim supersession fields normalize to one new-to-old edge.
Existing frozen CLI behavior distinguishes auxiliary plain Markdown from canonical Markdown by frontmatter or stable-ID filename; all canonical-zone YAML and JSON files are typed candidates.
Omitting a freshness probe is quiet for canonical-only validation; explicitly using NullFreshnessProbe reports unknown as an advisory.
decisions: Use a two-pass read-only engine with in-memory indexes so reference and graph validation remain deterministic and adapter-independent.
Use integrated Pydantic domain models and workctx.domain.frontmatter at runtime; retain jsonschema only in development/report validation.
Use schema-path-aware reference extraction and validated JSON Pointer exceptions so arbitrary claim objects and locator paths are not misclassified.
Keep one executable diagnostic catalog as the source for emitted severities and repair actions, with an exact documentation table sync test.
security_considerations: Validation never executes or mutates workspace content and refuses symlink/junction traversal and unreadable subtrees.
Secret and probe diagnostics are sanitized and never expose matched values or raw exception details; fixtures are fictional.
Context boundary checks precede vocabulary and resolution, preventing cross-context index disclosure.
Portable artifact and repository path checks cover traversal, absolute and drive-relative forms, UNC paths, NTFS alternate streams, reserved names, control characters, and resolution failures.
migration_considerations: No persistent workspace, schema, or database migration is introduced.
New diagnostic codes and the optional ValidationIssue.repair_action field are additive; original CLI-consumed fields and properties remain available.
unresolved: The integration lead must connect the WP-210 SQLite-backed freshness implementation behind FreshnessProbe; this branch intentionally ships no adapter import.
recommended_next_action: Implementation lead review commit eedb5734c1c525308d969243e72174299923c34a, rerun the four required gates, connect the WP-210 freshness probe behind the protocol, and accept WP-220 if integration remains green.
